items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Remember when him and Ricard had a band together?

ctx.x: At that time when he had a bigger band, what you call him used to mostly lead these bands, Ricard. Remember when him and Ricard had a band together? That was before we got stuck playing bass. He used to lead the band.
I knew he played trumpet in the old days. I heard him once in a parade. He's a nice trumpet player.
